decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully limits displayed referral counts to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract records.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits mint statistics to the replacement contract and records the numbering restart at #1.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already requires the public prize-pool statistic to use only the replacement contract's new pool state.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts active dashboard ownership to successfully minted replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits active commission displays to replacement-contract referrals and excludes old-contract commission records.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already calculates the countdown from the replacement contract's fresh draw cycle and excludes old draw progress.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits visible tickets to replacement-contract NFTs and new draws while excluding old-contract ticket state.

Starting fresh on the replacement contract does not alter the candidate's metadata attributes; each active NFT can still expose its own mint number, ticket counter, badges, and access reference unchanged.
The contract migration and exclusion of old-contract records do not change the required image or cover-rendering behavior.
The accepted migration policy does not require the FAQ to describe legacy-contract handling, and its current product explanations remain valid for the active replacement contract.
The existing message-539 INTRODUCE already fully records the fresh replacement-contract state, numbering restart, exclusion of the old contract, and absence of copy migration.
The migration decision does not necessarily change the About page's product, referral, prize, or technology copy.
